title: Qwen Office Begins Internal Testing, Focusing on 25 Enterprise IM Capabilities and One-Stop Delivery of Various Forms of Products

content_html:
The AI office track has welcomed a new player, the intelligent office platform "Qwen Work" has quietly started its internal testing. The platform is positioned as an AI collaboration hub for professionals, and it has introduced six core capabilities for the complete workflow from "task to delivery," including enterprise IM collaboration, one-stop generation and editing of Office products, multimodal understanding and generation, full-stack web delivery, professional data source aggregation, and a skill market. These capabilities comprehensively cover specialized work packages for various professional positions such as HR, lawyers, finance, and analysts.

In terms of specific functional implementation, Qwen Work has integrated 25 enterprise IM capabilities including message group chat reading, attendance approval, and meeting schedules, achieving direct closure of the process within the collaboration chain. On the product side, it supports direct output and online editing of multiple forms of deliverables such as PPTX, Word, Excel, and independent web pages.

In addition, the platform supports accessing e-commerce back-end and social media data sources, and it opens up customized skills and expert packages through the skill market. With the client download opening and the web version about to be launched, Qwen Work is expected to further accelerate the popularization of AI-driven modern office models with its one-stop delivery capabilities and full-process security and compliance guarantees.

Address: https://qwenwork.cn/

content_html_zh:
AI办公赛道迎来了新玩家，智能办公平台“Qwen Work”已悄然开启内测。 该平台定位于专业人士的AI协作中心，引入了企业IM协作、Office产品一站式生成与编辑、多模态理解与生成、全栈Web交付、专业数据源聚合、技能市场等“任务到交付”全流程六大核心能力。 这些能力全面涵盖了人力资源、律师、财务、分析师等各种专业岗位的专业工作包。

在具体功能实现上，Qwen Work集成了消息群聊阅读、考勤审批、会议日程等25项企业IM能力，实现了协作链内流程的直接封闭。 产品方面，支持PPTX、Word、Excel、独立网页等多种形式的交付物的直接输出和在线编辑。

此外，平台支持接入电商后端和社交媒体数据源，并通过技能市场开放定制技能和专家包。 随着客户端下载开放和网页版即将推出，Qwen Work有望凭借一站式交付能力和全流程安全合规保障，进一步加速人工智能驱动的现代办公模式的普及。

地址：https://qwenwork.cn/
